title: Zip over two encoded word lists
statement: Let $g$ be any function from finite bit strings to finite bit strings, and let $q,l_1,l_2$ be finite bit strings. Encode $q$ together with the encodings of $l_1$ and $l_2$ as a nested pair. Applying $zipWithW$ to this encoding yields the concatenation of the encodings with empty second component of the outputs $g(\langle q,x,y\rangle)$, where $(x,y)$ ranges over the termwise pairs of words decoded from $l_1$ and $l_2$, stopping when either decoded list ends.
hypotheses_covered: An arbitrary function $g$ from finite bit strings to finite bit strings
